Calder — full documentation for LLMs. Mirrors /docs. Regenerate by hand when docs change.

WHAT CALDER IS
Transactional email infrastructure: one endpoint in, delivered events out.
Base URL: https://api.calder.com. Versioned: /v1/….

QUICKSTART (all languages, same call)
POST /v1/emails, headers Authorization: Bearer calder_sk_test_… and
Idempotency-Key: <uuid>, JSON body {from, to, subject, html|text}.
Response 202: {id, status: "queued"}. Test keys simulate; live keys deliver.
Node: fetch. Python: requests (pip install requests). Go: net/http stdlib
(+ github.com/google/uuid). PHP: cURL extension. Ruby: net/http stdlib.
cURL: raw flags. Shell: curl + poll loop; dated keys for cron (deploy-X-$(date +%F)).

SENDING
202 Accepted = queued, not delivered. Track by id in logs/timeline/webhooks.
Always send Idempotency-Key.

DOMAINS
POST /v1/domains {domain} → token + records. Create SPF/DKIM/DMARC TXT records,
POST /v1/domains/:id/verify (polls with backoff, specific failure reasons).
Continuous re-verification. Hosted (Vercel etc.) verification maps to an
Calder-managed subdomain — project ownership, not DNS control.

API KEYS
calder_sk_test_… (simulate, unmetered) vs calder_sk_live_… (deliver, metered).
Scoped per project+env, hashed at rest, shown once. Rotate by overlap;
revoke → immediate fail-closed.

WEBHOOKS
Events: email.queued/.sent/.delivered/.bounced/.complained/.failed/.opened/.clicked.
Register URL + event list → signing secret (shown once). Verify HMAC-SHA256
with timingSafeEqual. Dedupe on event ID. 200 fast, work async. Retries with
backoff; attempt history + manual replay in dashboard.

IDEMPOTENCY
Idempotency-Key required on POST /v1/emails. First request stores result per
project; repeats within 24h return it with 200. UUID per operation; dated keys
for cron. No double-send, no double-meter.

SUPPRESSION
Bounces/complaints/unsubscribes auto-suppress with logged reason. Sends to
suppressed addresses return a "suppressed" error naming reason + event. Manual
entries supported, reversible, audited.

USAGE & BILLING
Billable = one 202. Webhooks/reads/retries/test traffic free. Aggregated from
durable records. Plans: Free 3,000/mo; Starter ₦5,000/$7 25,000; Pro
₦12,000/$15 100,000; Scale ₦45,000/$50 500,000. Hard limits, no overages.

TEMPLATES (soon) / OTP (soon)
Not shipped. Templates: versioned, variables, previews (planned). OTP: managed
challenges (planned). Today: send rendered HTML; generate/verify codes yourself
(short TTL, 5-attempt cap).

ERRORS
Always {error: {code, message, request_id}}. Codes: validation_error,
authentication_error, authorization_error, domain_not_verified, suppressed,
rate_limit_error, not_found, provider_error. Quote request_id for support.

RATE LIMITS
Sending 100/min, verification 10/min, auth 20/min, OTP 5/min. 429s carry
limit/remaining/reset/Retry-After.

MIGRATION (/migrate)
Same concepts, mechanical steps: provider.emails.send() → POST /v1/emails
(same fields, 202 + {id, status} instead of 200 + {id}); add Idempotency-Key
on the move; re-register webhook endpoints + secrets; export suppression lists
and re-import; run both providers in parallel, flip per project, then cancel.
Broadcast suites have no equivalent — transactional only, by design.

SECURITY (developer summary)
Env/secret-manager keys, never client/git. Test/live cryptographically distinct.
HMAC-verify webhooks. Full policy: SECURITY.md; posture: /security.
Report: support@calder.click, subject "security".
